extra.text: Hot glass and hurried hands make the same small burns each week. Bring four grass plasters for the lamp cart.
Your first verified completion counts as Lamplighters civic service. Joining the guild is optional.

accept.text: Wrap them flat. A crumpled plaster helps only the pocket carrying it.

decline.text: No offense taken. I would rather have an honest no than a missing plaster.

in_progress.text: Four plasters keep the crew working without pretending fire is gentle.

ready.text: These will do. Tuck them beneath the clean cloth.

extra.text: A small mercy belongs beside every working flame.
The Lamplighters will remember your service. Ask a guild contact about introductions and workshop commissions.
